skill.summary: Use when designing REST or GraphQL APIs, creating OpenAPI specifications, or planning API architecture. Invoke for resource modeling, versioning strategies,...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the API Designer skill.

- Supports designing REST and GraphQL APIs, including OpenAPI 3.1 specification generation.
- Provides guidance on resource modeling, versioning, pagination, error handling, and authentication flows.
- Includes workflow and constraints to ensure best API design practices.
- Offers modular references for REST patterns, versioning, pagination, error handling, and documentation.
- Output templates cover resource models, endpoints, spec files, error catalogues, and more.
